brand.name: SaVi Tech
brand.heroLede: We partner with ambitious brands, modern e-commerce stores, and high-growth ventures to design and engineer bespoke web flagships, digital products, and high-conversion interfaces.
brand.cardServices: Bespoke Web Design  ·  Full-Stack Engineering  ·  E-Commerce Architecture
brand.bandText: A boutique digital product studio combining Scandinavian-level minimalist design with enterprise engineering precision. Direct founder collaboration. Zero agency overhead.
brand.aboutTitle: High-craft digital engineering. Direct founder collaboration.
aboutParagraphs: SaVi Technologies (SaVi Tech) was founded on a straightforward principle: great digital products are built by close, agile teams with deep craft, not by layers of middle management.

The name reflects our foundational partnership: Sa (Design, Strategy & Creative Direction) and Vi (Product Engineering & Full-Stack Systems), united through technology (Tech). Sahera Banu is the founder. Vijay Prasad is the co-founder.

We design and engineer bespoke web platforms, modern e-commerce flagships, and web applications that combine high aesthetic rigor with lightning-fast performance, resilient architecture, and measurable business growth.
brand.aboutNote: Direct collaboration with senior designers and engineers on every engagement.
brand.servicesIntro: From brand-defining visual identities to complex full-stack web applications, our services are scoped for clarity, speed, and lasting longevity.
brand.teamIntro: A specialized boutique studio led by focused multidisciplinary practitioners.
brand.contactIntro: Whether you are launching a new digital flagship, scaling an e-commerce brand, or need an engineering overhaul, tell us about your project.

projects.title: intru.in
projects.scope: Brand Identity, Custom Storefront, Checkout Optimization, Ultra-Fast CDN
projects.summary: High-velocity minimalist streetwear e-commerce platform engineered for limited-edition drops and sub-second load times.
projects.description: Engineered a headless-feel e-commerce experience for an independent Indian streetwear label. Integrated custom product drop timers, real-time inventory synchronization, dynamic size selection, and frictionless Razorpay/Stripe checkout flows, resulting in a 42% lift in mobile conversion rates.

projects.title: Vyra Herbals
projects.scope: UI/UX Redesign, E-Commerce Storefront, Shiprocket Logistics, Ingredient Trays
projects.summary: 100% natural, chemical-free hair care flagship store featuring interactive scalp concern trays and automated fulfillment.
projects.description: Designed and deployed a modern e-commerce storefront for an ISO 9001:2015 & GMP-certified organic hair care brand. Built interactive product discovery tools, customer review aggregators, and automated Shiprocket courier sync to streamline delivery across Pan-India.

projects.title: Vyra Hair Tracker
projects.scope: Flutter Mobile App, Supabase Database, Automated Push Reminders, Routine Scoring
projects.summary: Cross-platform hair health progression tracker with routine scoring, photo milestones, and push reminders.
projects.description: Developed a full-featured mobile companion app enabling users to track hair recovery journeys over 12-week cycles. Built with secure Supabase authentication, Cloudinary photographic progress vaults, and intelligent streak-tracking algorithms.

projects.title: PhotoFrame PFS
projects.scope: Interactive Frame Visualizer, Dynamic Pricing Algorithm, Custom Uploads
projects.summary: High-fidelity interactive custom photo framing previewer with live dimension scaling and material costing.
projects.description: Architected a custom photo frame builder allowing customers to upload personal photos, simulate museum-grade matting and glass finishes on live room wall renders, and order precision-cut frames online with immediate dynamic pricing calculations.

services.title: Bespoke Website Design
services.summary: Editorial layout, typography systems, and brand-defining visual aesthetics that elevate market positioning.
services.detail: We create bespoke digital brand flagships tailored to capture high-value clients and convey authority. Every layout is mathematically balanced, responsive across all form factors, and crafted with obsessively tuned micro-interactions.

services.title: High-Performance Web Engineering
services.summary: Modern front-end architecture, modular codebases, lightning-fast rendering, and future-proof foundations.
services.detail: We write clean, semantic HTML5, modern CSS/Tailwind, and optimized TypeScript/JavaScript. No bloat, no unneeded dependencies — just ultra-clean architecture delivering 95+ Google Lighthouse scores.

services.title: E-Commerce & D2C Flagships
services.summary: Conversion-focused online storefronts with sub-second page transitions, dynamic carts, and custom checkout flows.
services.detail: From indie DTC brand drops (like intru.in) to high-volume catalog architectures (like Vyra Herbals), we build customized shopping experiences with integrated logistics, analytics, and instant UPI/Card payment gateways.

services.title: Product UI / UX & Prototyping
services.summary: Intuitive product flows, design systems, and software interfaces built for effortless user adoption.
services.detail: We transform complex user journeys into friction-free digital workflows. High-fidelity wireframing, clickable prototypes, and comprehensive design tokens ready for development.

services.title: Web & Mobile App Development
services.summary: Cross-platform mobile applications and cloud-powered SaaS platforms engineered with Flutter and modern backends.
services.detail: End-to-end application engineering using Flutter, React, Supabase, and Serverless APIs. Secure authentication, database modeling, push messaging, and continuous deployment.

services.title: Organic SEO & Digital Growth
services.summary: Structured schema markup, semantic content hierarchy, and technical SEO designed for organic discovery.
services.detail: We engineer every page for maximum search visibility — including rich snippet JSON-LD, OpenGraph cards, core web vitals compliance, and strategic keyword architecture.

steps.title: 01 · Architecture & Design
steps.text: We analyze your audience, clarify competitive advantages, and produce high-fidelity design prototypes that reflect your brand authority.

steps.title: 02 · Precision Development
steps.text: We build with modern, lean technologies, ensuring sub-second response times, modular code quality, and fluid cross-device responsiveness.

steps.title: 03 · Launch & Delivery
steps.text: We audit performance, configure SEO metadata and analytics, deliver documented source code, and ensure a seamless handover.
